classification: External control + observation works, WebOS not connected
summary: Built continuous cognitive live loop: external controller sends commands, HSE executes on GL thread, observations returned via named pipe
limitations: WebOS is not actually connected (protocol ready)
Controller is deterministic, not AI cognition
Frame capture is base64, not compressed image format

built.stable_object_ids: uint64 monotonically increasing, stored on Primitive
built.command_sequence_numbers: seq field in Command and all acks
built.bidirectional_communication: Named pipe full-duplex, observations sent back
built.observation_protocol: 6 types: scene, object, camera, health, delta, frame_capture
built.delta_observations: Snapshot-based diff, reports only changes since known revision
built.failure_handling: Invalid objects, invalid commands, queue overflow all fail gracefully

executables.hse_bridge_app: Bridge with named pipe server + observations
